## Breaking change
<!--

Attributes from the vacuum platform have been replaced with sensors.
This means that all your references to these attributes must be replaced with its sensor.
Some sensors have been disabled by default and need manual enablement once the integration has been set up.

e.g. the attribute `mop_attached: true` has now been replaced with `binary_sensor.<NAME>_mop_attached`

issue_context.title: Xiaomi Miio: Roborock s7: mop attached attribute incorrect
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The `Mop attached` attribute for Roborock s7 is set to true even though the mop is not attached. This is because the s7's mob is no longer attached to the water tank. Hence the following code is incorrect for s7:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/1d9d9021deed31337910a4a8d80feb665d33d0b0/homeassistant/components/xiaomi_miio/vacuum.py#L343

This code needs to be modified for the s7 and introduce another attribute "Water box attached". Would such change be welcoming?

core-2021.5.5

review_comments: Please move or remove all the logging in entity properties. We don't want side effects in those.

Where do you propose to move this particular logline?

Are you suggesting moving this logic to the coordinator?

If we want to keep the logging we can define `_handle_coordinator_update` in the entity class and set instance attributes with the state, and log if needed.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/0dc8fb497b1162c08286dfd03f54da3d237f38dd/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py#L322-L325

This method is not available in the coordinator class that we are using here. The coordinator that is being used is this one: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/f1a4ba8bb0a7b241e69eacc75f194a78d0490535/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py#L33
The coordinator will tell the coordinator entity to update state and the default method that handles the update in the CoordinatorEntity is  `_handle_coordinator_update`.

```suggestion
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
```

I don't think it's "homeassistant-esque", but if it's allowed by the coding standards / reviewers, I would rather get rid of the overuse of consts inside the integration, and rather use a dataclass-based container for the coordinator data.

This would allow easier extending later on thanks to type hints:
```
@dataclass
class VacuumCoordinatorData:
    status: VacuumStatus
    dnd_status: VacuumDnDStatus
    ...
```
I didn't catch this before. This PR removed fix for `-9999` error added here https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/56288
